steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A claim must be within the limit, have a receipt reference and not be a duplicate.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Claim over the limit
findings.fix: Return the claim or get the approval

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] claim-0902.md:12  Claim over the limit.
       Fix: Return the claim or get the approval.
[high] claim-0905.md:19  Duplicate claim.
       Fix: Reject the duplicate.
[medium] claim-0903.md:26  Claim with no receipt reference.
       Fix: Attach the receipt.
Not checked: Whether the expense was business-related.
pros: Checks a claim over the limit, a claim with no receipt reference, and a duplicate claim.
cons: Not checked: Whether the expense was business-related.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-expense-policy-check skill on the records for this review.
